title: Article 246 — Subject-matter of laws made by Parliament and by the Legislatures of States

content.heading: Subject-matter of laws made by Parliament and by the Legislatures of States
content.text: Notwithstanding anything in clauses (2) and (3), Parliament has exclusive power to make laws with respect to any of the matters enumerated in List I in the Seventh Schedule (Union List). Notwithstanding anything in clause (3), Parliament, and, subject to clause (1), the Legislature of any State also, have power to make laws with respect to any of the matters enumerated in List III (Concurrent List). Subject to clauses (1) and (2), the Legislature of any State has exclusive power to make laws for such State or any part thereof with respect to any of the matters enumerated in List II (State List).
